gaps.sentence: It's hard to reason ___ someone in a panic.
gaps.explanation: reason with somebody = try to persuade them logically.

gaps.sentence: She keyed ___ the password and logged on.
gaps.explanation: key in = type in (a password, code).

gaps.sentence: The new manager wants to back ___ the sales team's proposal.
gaps.explanation: back up = support (a person, plan); also make a copy of data.

gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
The hotel was full, so we couldn't check ___.
gaps.explanation: check in = register; check out = leave and pay.

gaps.sentence: I can't make ___ what the sign says from here.
gaps.explanation: make out = see, hear or understand with difficulty.

gaps.sentence: I fell ___ with my best friend over a silly remark.
gaps.explanation: fall out (with somebody) = have an argument and stop being friendly.
